_comment_: Markdown is excluded from editorconfig-checker because YAML / bash / k8s manifest samples inside fenced code blocks legitimately use language-specific indents (e.g. YAML list-item continuation aligns at column 10 / 22) that the line-level checker would flag as non-multiple-of-4. Markdown style is enforced by markdownlint + prettier instead.
_comment_repowiki_: repowiki's configmap.yaml embeds generate.py verbatim from upstream (joryirving/home-ops) as a ConfigMap block-scalar string, kept byte-identical (besides the git identity/env values) so upstream fixes stay easy to pull in. Its Python continuation lines hang-indent to an opening paren (PEP8-legal, not multiple-of-2), which the line-level checker would otherwise flag.
